summary.text: Ray Reed, listed by Ballotpedia as Raymond Reed, is a Democratic state representative from Missouri House of Representatives District 83, an office he has held since January 2025, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as party affairs organizer with the Missouri Democratic Party.

paragraphs.text: Ray Reed was born in St. Louis, Missouri, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Central Missouri in 2018.
Ballotpedia says his career experience includes working as a party affairs organizer with the Missouri Democratic Party.
Reed assumed office on January 8, 2025, succeeding Sarah Unsicker, and advanced from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary.
His 2025-2026 committee assignment is the Professional Registration and Licensing Committee.
